items.title: 19:00 ON TIME
items.medium: Chalk, extracts from personal diary, Iphone notes etc.
items.description:
Text work as part of the performance event 19:00 ON TIME made together with Line Rolf, Lukas Moland and Steinar Brovold Hauge at the top floor of the parking house Bergen Bygarage.\
\
As the event was determined by the boundaries of a parking lot as a public gray zone, the text pieces written with chalk would stay for as long it would take for rain and cars to rub it away.

items.title: Start´19
items.venue: The Sculpture Workshop of the The Danish National Museum
items.medium: Dried rubber tree leaves, thread of silk and steel
items.description:
Part of the group show Efterglød - an annual exhibition by Sydhavn Theater and ST:ART, showing video works in public spaces around the neighborhood of Sydhavn, Copenhagen. \
The video is made of text pieces and footage recorded on a trip to the volcano Etna in Siciliy. While tourists are walking down the slope creating dust clouds, the exceptional heat were making thousands of lady bugs flying up the volcano only to be trapped and die of hunger. Meanwhile a forest fire was delaying airplanes for take off.
